verses.1: The firmament on high is his beauty; it is the beauty of heaven in a vision of glory.
verses.2: The sun, at its appearance, announces its journey; it is an instrument of wonder, a work of the Most High.
verses.3: At midday, it scorches the earth. And in the presence of its heat, who would be able to endure? It is like the custodian of a furnace in its works of heat.
verses.4: In three ways, the sun acts: scorching the mountains, emitting fiery rays, and shining with its beams that can blind the eyes.
verses.5: Great is the Lord who made it, and at his word, it hurries on its journey.
verses.6: And the moon, in all its phases, serves to mark the seasons and to be a sign of the times.
verses.7: From the moon is the sign of a feast day; it is a light which diminishes at its consummation.
verses.8: A month is named according to its phases, increasing wonderfully at its culmination.
verses.9: It is an instrument of the armies on high, shining gloriously in the firmament of heaven.
verses.10: The glory of the stars is the beauty of heaven; the Lord illuminates the world from on high.
verses.11: At the words of the Holy One, they stand for judgment, and they will never fail in their vigilance.
verses.12: Consider the rainbow, and bless the One who made it; it is very beautiful in its splendor.
verses.13: It encompasses the heavens with the circle of its glory; the hands of the Most High made it appear.
verses.14: By his order, he hastens the snow, and he spurs on the lightning to express his judgment.
verses.15: In like manner, his storehouses are opened, and the clouds fly out like birds.
verses.16: By his greatness, he has positioned the clouds, and the hailstones have been broken.
verses.17: At his glance, the mountains will be shaken, and by his will, the south wind will blow.
verses.18: The voice of his thunder will reverberate through the earth, by a storm from the north, and by a gathering of the whirlwind.
verses.19: And like the birds landing in a flock upon the earth, he sends down the snow; and its descent is like the arrival of a swarm of locusts.
verses.20: The eye is in wonder at the beauty of its whiteness, and the heart is astonished at its falling.
verses.21: He will pour out frost like salt upon the earth. And when it freezes, it will become like the tops of thistles.
verses.22: The cold north wind blows, and the water freezes into crystals; it will rest upon every gathering of water, and it will clothe the water like a breastplate.
verses.23: And it will devour the mountains, and burn the wilderness, and extinguish the greenery, like a fire.
verses.24: Relief for all is in the hurried arrival of a cloud. And the lowly dew will arrive to meet the heat and overpower it.
verses.25: At his word, the wind grows quiet, and by his thought, he appeases the abyss, for the Lord has planted islands in it.
verses.26: Let those who navigate the sea describe its perils. And when we have heard it with our ears, we will wonder.
verses.27: There are illustrious and wondrous works: the various kinds of wild animals, and all manner of cattle, and the great creatures of the sea.
verses.28: Through him, the end of their journey is confirmed, and by his word, all things fit together.
verses.29: We can say much, and yet still lack for words. But the consummation of our words is this: He is in all things.
verses.30: What would we be able to do to glorify him? For the Almighty himself is above all his own works.
verses.31: The Lord is terrible, and exceedingly great, and his power is wonderful.
verses.32: Glorify the Lord as much as you are able, yet still he will far exceed this. For his magnificence is beyond wonder.
verses.33: Bless the Lord and exalt him, as much as you are able. But he is beyond all praise.
verses.34: When you exalt him, use all your ability, and do not cease in this labor. For you can never comprehend him.
verses.35: Who will see him and explain? And who will magnify him, as he is from the beginning?
verses.36: There are many things, hidden from us, which are greater than these things. For we have seen but a few of his works.
verses.37: But the Lord has made all things, and he has given wisdom to those who act with piety. [ Sirach 44 ]
